item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01965","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 110 + 310 + 215 + 560 + 780 as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Reports the weekly requirement of 28 people as the daily requirement, omitting division by seven.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly written sum; the second answers a weekly quantity when a daily quantity is requested.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01966","case1_error":"Treats the stated four overtime hours as occurring each day, multiplying their pay by five.","case2_error":"Counts only the extra day's 50% premium, omitting its base daily pay.","reason":"The first repeats overtime pay across days; the second omits a required component of overtime-day compensation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01967","case1_error":"Adds the 21, 4, and 18 books to the initial collection instead of counting them among donated books.","case2_error":"Leading answer marker says 198, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 500 pages.","reason":"The second has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01968","case1_error":"Incorrectly equates the remaining two patients' total to 25 − 6, contradicts x = 6, then doubles that total.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 5 + 20 + 18 as 41 instead of 43.","reason":"The first introduces invalid relations and double-counts a total; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01969","case1_error":"Subtracts six inches from the rim height instead of adding them to set the required reach.","case2_error":"Leading answer marker says 1000, but the derivation and final answer correctly give $1250.","reason":"The first reverses the required height relation; the second has only an answer-marker conflict, requiring an uncertain judgment.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
